decisions.reason: The end-of-day deadline changes completion timing for the enumerated assignments but does not change the fallback behavior used when assigned work is unavailable.
The source changes assignment deadlines but does not change where completed artifacts or supporting links must be stored.
The source does not change how completed subtasks or goal parent tasks must be marked in ClickUp.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the end-of-day deadline for the daily Airbnb outreach assignment.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the content bank's end-of-day completion deadline.
A deadline for Airbnb outreach does not necessarily change the separate spreadsheet-based tracking and later CRM-entry workflow for interested leads.

The deadline applies to CJ Dropshipping Task 3 and related daily work, but the supplied evidence does not safely establish whether Task 3 is specifically the product-research behavior rather than a listing behavior.
The source assigns a deadline to daily outreach but does not change the separate requirement for determining the next step in an interested host conversation.

CJ Dropshipping Task 3 may include publishing selected products to Thai Market Finds, but the supplied evidence does not unambiguously map Task 3 or the related daily work to this specific listing requirement.
CJ Dropshipping Task 3 may include TikTok Shop listing work, but the supplied evidence does not unambiguously establish that the end-of-day deadline applies to this specific atomic requirement.
The enumerated end-of-day assignments do not include the earlier CRM structure document task.
The assignment deadline does not change the requirement that shared Canva and Adobe Express credentials be visible through Bitwarden.
